target: same-node provider speed snapshot at origin + H; not an hourly average
input_capture_rule: capture <= origin, exact slot, original finite non-imputed speed
reference_capture_rule: capture > origin; train/validation capture < partition_end; test obtained after decision
candidate_grid: all 51 nodes x all 2304 decision slots, independently for each H
issue_eligibility: known calendar same-partition target and all five inputs visible; never conditional on future reference existence
scoring_eligibility: issue eligibility then independently join valid future reference
quantile_method: linear on all 51 unrounded availability values
stratum_rule: Low <= q1; Medium q1 < A <= q2; High > q2; ties not split
timestamp_semantics_status: record-time proxy conditionally supported, actual online arrival unproved
speed_scaling: five columns, fitted on each H scorable training set; population sd ddof=0; constant scale=1
calendar_encoding: minute-of-local-day sin/cos, weekday Monday=0; 7 and 51 full indicators; non-speed features unscaled
alpha_selection: minimum common validation MAE; choose largest alpha within minimum+1e-12
training_weights: all rows equal; strata are not features or weights
prediction_reference_isolation: write all issuable predictions before attaching references for that H
user_figure_preference: text instructions and actual CSV only; no generated plots
